jobs.subject: A sunny dinosaur valley. A big friendly green long-neck dinosaur drinks from a blue river, a small orange triceratops child plays beside it, a baby dinosaur hatches from a spotted egg in a nest, a pterosaur glides in the sky, palm trees, giant ferns and a gently smoking volcano in the distance.

A sunny dinosaur valley. A big friendly green long-neck dinosaur drinks from a blue river, a small orange triceratops child plays beside it, a baby dinosaur hatches from a spotted egg in a nest, a pterosaur glides in the sky, palm trees, giant ferns and a gently smoking volcano in the distance.

A busy construction site. A big yellow excavator digs a hole and loads earth into an orange dump truck, a red crane lifts a wooden beam, a blue concrete mixer waits, traffic cones, a pile of sand, a half-built brick house, two friendly builders with yellow helmets wave.

A big fire engine seen from the side, with a ladder on the roof, a hose reel, big wheels and a friendly firefighter waving from the window. A few simple clouds and a sun.

A happy cartoon T-Rex dinosaur sits in the driver's seat of a big excavator and drives it. The excavator has a large digging arm with a bucket and caterpillar tracks. A small pile of earth and a simple hill behind.

A construction site with exactly two separate machines. On the left stands a big yellow excavator on its own caterpillar tracks, its long arm lifts a bucket full of earth, a friendly builder sits in its cab. On the right, a few steps away and not touching it, stands an orange dump truck with six wheels and an empty tipper. Between them a pile of sand and two traffic cones. Behind them a half-built brick house and green trees.

A little town built entirely from colourful plastic toy building bricks with round studs on top: brick houses in red, blue and yellow, a brick tower, a brick bridge, a small brick train on brick rails and brick trees, standing on a green baseplate. The studs are plain and smooth with nothing printed on them.
A yellow excavator with caterpillar tracks, a long digging arm with a bucket and a friendly builder in the cab.
A friendly green baby T-Rex dinosaur standing on two legs, smiling with its mouth closed, small arms, big round eyes.
A small tower built from six colourful plastic toy building bricks with plain round studs on top, in red, blue, yellow and green. Nothing is printed on the studs.

A simple toy car built from big plastic building bricks with round studs on top, seen from the side, with four large round wheels. Very simple, only a few big shapes. A straight ground line under the wheels.
